description: This file defines a Razor PageModel class 'CheckoutModel' for handling the checkout process in an ASP.NET Core web application. It manages user authentication, basket retrieval, order creation, and cookie management related to the shopping basket.

classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: PageModel class for handling checkout page interactions; manages basket retrieval, order creation, user sign-in state, and cookie management.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to load the checkout page; populates the basket model.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles form submissions for checkout; updates basket quantities, creates an order, deletes the basket, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: SetBasketModelAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the basket based on whether the user is signed in or anonymous.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Manages the retrieval or creation of a basket cookie and associated username for anonymous users.
